claims: The native wrapper pushes mode 0x08 and calls the shared AutoCal dispatcher at 0x00517568.
The native sender at 0x00512280 sends service 0x24 with four payload bytes containing subcommand 0x04 and the wrapper mode; the resulting host frame is 02 24 04 08 32.
The shared dispatcher requires connection and operator confirmation before the native send.
On successful send it waits 1000 ms and then forces the common AutoCal refresh path 0x005162F8.
This completely reconstructs the behavior implemented by ProgBase for this action.
evidence: Raw RTTI + disassembly run 35809435511: ActionAutoMatchExecute -> 0x005189B4 -> push 0x08 -> call 0x00517568.
0x00512280 calls TAebProtocol_SendCommand with service 0x24, payload length 4 and action byte passed from the wrapper.
0x00517568 checks protocol connection, asks for confirmation, invokes 0x00512280, Sleep(1000) on success and calls 0x005162F8.
Neither canonical Portmon capture contains 02 24 04 08 32; therefore no firmware-internal selective mutation is claimed from the supplied captures.

epistemic_boundary.rationale: Atlas reconstructs ProgBase. Firmware-internal behavior not observable in the canonical host binary/captures is not fabricated and is not treated as a missing ProgBase code path.
